entities.summary: Henrique Rocha is a Portuguese professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 131 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 166 achieved on 9 September 2024. He is currently the No. 2 singles player from Portugal.
